title: ALI Data Reconciliation Complete — Manual Dispatch Verified

fields.incidentName: Silent Calls — CAD/AVL Integrity & Service Continuity
fields.from: Frontline Staff (Supervisor Greene, Call Takers 4 & 9, Dispatcher 7)
fields.to: Incident Commander (Dir), Floor Supervisor (Sup), Technical Lead (Tech)
fields.summary: All 17 calls with corrupted ALI data have been reconciled. Verification was completed using field radio logs (12), RCECD-F-11 run cards, and a 24-hour audit of unit movements. Medic 3 was on scene at the Marlow structure fire for 42 minutes; CAD had incorrectly shown them as available. Engine 4 was dispatched to a false address due to ALI spoofing but was corrected via field radio. All unit statuses now match field reports. Manual dispatch tracking on the whiteboard and printed map book is fully aligned with on-scene operations. No further data corruption is suspected.

actions.text: Initiated 24-hour audit of unit movements across all active calls
Cross-checked 12 ALI-corrupted calls against radio logs and RCECD-F-11 run cards
Confirmed Medic 3's on-scene time and location at Marlow fire
Verified Engine 4's correction via field radio report; dispatched to correct address

planned: Begin vendor access request for restore under RCECD-OPS-2026, Section 5, T-2 Contain

instructorNote: This inject confirms full reconciliation of ALI data under manual operations. The team must now validate that manual tracking is stable before proceeding to restore.
